mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE boardType = 11
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE boardType = 11 AND boardDate <= #{targetDate} + 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.boardId) FROM BOARD b JOIN COMMENTS c ON b.boardId = c.boardId AND b.boardType = c.boardType WHERE b.boardType = 11
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.boardId) FROM BOARD b JOIN COMMENTS c ON b.boardId = c.boardId AND b.boardType = c.boardType WHERE b.boardType = 11 AND b.boardDate <= #{targetDate} + 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD b WHERE b.boardType = 11 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.boardId = b.boardId AND c.boardType = b.boardType )

SELECT NVL(AVG((firstCommentDate - boardDate) * 24), 0) FROM ( SELECT b.boardId, b.boardDate, MIN(c.commentsDate) AS firstCommentDate FROM BOARD b INNER JOIN COMMENTS c ON b.boardId = c.boardId AND b.boardType = c.boardType WHERE b.boardType = 11 GROUP BY b.boardId, b.boardDate )

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN c.boardId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS completedCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.boardId IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS pendingCnt FROM BOARD b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT boardId, boardType FROM COMMENTS ) c ON b.boardId = c.boardId AND b.boardType = c.boardType WHERE b.boardType = 11 AND b.boardDate >= #{startDate} AND b.boardDate < #{endDate} + 1

WITH date_range AS ( SELECT TRUNC(#{startDate}) + LEVEL - 1 AS dt FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TRUNC(#{endDate}) - TRUNC(#{startDate}) + 1 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(d.dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDate, NVL(COUNT(b.boardDate), 0) AS cnt FROM date_range d LEFT JOIN BOARD b ON TRUNC(b.boardDate) = d.dt AND b.boardType = 11 GROUP BY d.dt ORDER BY d.dt
